text_block_list.text:
Бива Хаяхидэ has a severe injury, so I
cancel
practice and go visit her to drop
some things off.

Hello! If you're looking for Hayahide,
she left for
the gym a little while ago.
text_block_list.name: Infirmary Doctor

text_block_list.text: Pant... pant... I didn't think... this injury would... affect me so much...
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: Trainer!
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
I know. I'm sorry, but please, don't
worry.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
I suffered a major injury as a child, so I
know what
a setback it can be.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
That's why I don't want to waste any
time. I want
to continue refining my
equations instead.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
I'll pay close attention to my injury while
still
carrying out my calculations, so
please...
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: Please don't stop me from progressing!
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ
choice_data_list: We need to go back to the infirmary.

If you're so intent on doing this... then we'll do
it together!

text_block_list.text:
...I see. So I have no choice but to stand
still as
everyone sprints on ahead again...
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ
choice_data_list: If your injury gets worse, you'll never catch up to them.

text_block_list.text:
You're right. I know that... Intellectually,
anyway.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
I know I can't make the same mistake I
did in the
past. But...
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: No, never mind. I'll do as you say.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Thank you... Thank you for
understanding. Let's
get started!
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: Ah!
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: Thud!
I-I'm fine... I just... I just tripped.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
After that, I start working with her on
testing out
her calculations.

I see... According to this heart rate... the
amount
of muscular exertion decreased,
just as I
predicted.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: Phew... Well, that was productive. I even learned about things unrelated to my calculations.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
I realized that I have other advantages
besides
my analytical skills. I have
someone beside me,
willing to go over
theories and calculations
together, all
for the sake of improvement.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Бива Хаяхидэ struggles mightily with
her fears of
falling behind, but agrees to
rest and recuperate.

Бива Хаяхидэ is so overwrought by her
first
injury that she ends up giving
herself another. It'll
take even longer for
her to heal now...

What I'm saying is... that you're
incredibly
important to me. I can't wait
to start training
again.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ
